# ClusteringAlignment

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The correspondence of community or cluster structure in a network across different populations or between humans and models. Serves as a benchmark for evaluating whether in-network neuromorphic systems preserve functional modularity akin to human cognition.
